periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical-oblique orientation, tilted forward relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape with a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, placing the lowest point significantly below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior margin of the dark band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Covers approximately 30% of the visible torso region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation between the ear regions on the cranial vault.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark, circular focal lesion or aperture in the ventral/pelvic region.
